O 


March 17th, 1980 


THE MONTREAL YMCA IS BACK IN POINTE. ST-CHARLES 
————— SO DAUR LN FUINTE- ST-CHARLES 


The Montreal YMCA and the Montreal Boys' and Girls' Association, with the coopera- 
tion of Centraide, have recently signed an agreement which allows the YMCA 

to use and occupy the Pointe St-Charles Boys' and Girls' Club (255 Ash St.) 

The MBGA had recently announced that it intended to close this community 

center. 


The YMCA had founded a recreational center in Pointe St-Charles as early as 
1867, but was forced to shut its doors after less than two years. Now, 


one hundred years later, the YMCA is most enthusiastic and determined about 
making comeback. 


In the months to come, the YMCA will be busy identifying the social, cultural and 
recreational needs of the area. The Association will also develop a system 
enabling it to meet the expectations of the Pointe St-Charles community. 


This is a great challenge the YMCA has accepted. 


The official opening of the Pointe St-Charles YMCA community center will be 
announced at a later date.
